title: 熱力学
subtitle: Thermodynamics
keywords: Heat energy 2.First law of thermodynamics 3.Ideal gas 4.Second law of thermodynamics 5.Entropy
educationalGoal: Students will: (1)learn the relationship between heat energy and material properties (2)learn the formulation of this relationship
advice: This is a basic thermodynamics course.We will cover the following materials: 1.Lecture and exercises on heat equilibrium. 2,Lecture and exercises on technical terms and SI unit. 3.Lecture and exercises on first law of thermodynamics. 4.Lecture and exercises on gases and the state equation of an ideal gas. 5.Lecture and exercises on second law of thermodynamics and entropy. Students will also learn about advanced issues such as the state equation of existing gases on their own. Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms and formulas. Students are expected to solve advanced exercises on their own. Students should be aware of the teacher's instructions in the class,because the schedules of quizzes,tests and reports may change as the class progresses.
books: Textbooks:Mechanical Engineering Series 2 Thermodynamics(Asakura Shoten) Reference books:None Reserved books:None
requiredKnowledge: Sufficient skill in mathematics(especially differential/integral calculations) How to use a calculator.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain heat equilibrium and adapt it to solve practical problems.
Be able to explain the first law of thermodynamics.
Be able to solve practical problems concerning the first law of thermodynamics.
Be able to explain the state equation of an ideal gas,state change of an ideal gas,and solve practical problems.
Be able to explain the second law of thermodynamics,the Carnot cycle and entropy,and adapt them to solve practic

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
